title: Recruiter | Manufacturing Industry
description:
The Recruiter is responsible for Service Excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. They act as a brand ambassador for the client, focused on delivering exceptional talent while providing proactive and timely communication on the status of the search. They serve as subject matter expert in talent acquisition and provide consultative direction and industry expertise to hiring leader.

•
Work Location: Mexico

•
Work Arrangement: Remote

•
Specific requirements: At least 2 years of experience recruiting for blue-collar or manufacturing positions for MX.

•
Language Required: Proficiency in English

Responsibilities:

• Finding Candidates: - Lead a detailed job scope meeting with the hiring leader to determine position specifications, providing relevant market data and recommendations on possible approaches to the search or candidate requirements.

• Review of candidates who have applied via the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

• Evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements and determine who to move forward in the recruitment process.

• Develop and manage recruitment marketing plans or sourcing plans to determine the most appropriate candidate sources that align to the search requirements.

• Source candidates via resume databases, search engine and networking sites using Boolean search language.

• Solicit and pursue referrals from business networks and/or internal referrals.

• Utilize Cielo ’s proprietary software for mobile and email campaigning to talent communities.

• Engaging Candidates: - Use an appropriate mix of media to connect with talent communities (phone, email, social media, etc.).

• Articulate value proposition to candidates who are interested in the job opportunity.

• Prepare candidates for interviews, coaching them on logistical information, interview schedule, appropriate attire and overall expectations.

• Ensure candidates are provided with timely updates concerning the status of their applications and interviews.

• Assessing Candidates: - Draft and utilize phone interview templates appropriate to the job description.

• Use independent judgement to compare candidate phone interview notes and skills assessments with position requirements to determine if the candidate is a match for the role or a potential match for other open positions.

• Issue skills testing as needed and evaluate results (if process dictates).

• Review background and reference information (if process dictates).

• Influencing the Hire: - Keep candidates engaged throughout process, ensuring consistent communication on the status of the search.

• Partner with hiring leader to determine offer details, using market data and compensation guidelines to support recommendations.

• Articulate a job offer to candidate and drive for candidate acceptance, anticipating and negotiating counter-offers as appropriate.

• Service Excellence: - Strict adherence to all regulations (OFCCP and all other compliance standards set forth).

• Work to deliver a strong candidate slate, continuously building talent pipelines to ensure there are multiple qualified candidates in play at all times.

• Provide accurate and regular reporting of recruiting activities to the hiring leader and Cielo leadership to depict both metrics and efforts.

• Identify perceived difficulties with searches and research and recommend solutions to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Proactively and regularly communicate the status of each search to the hiring leader, providing a consultative approach with recommendations on how to move forward.

Education:

• High school diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in business, management, human resources or related field is strongly preferred.
Experience:

• Minimum of two or more years’ recruiting experience with demonstrated successes in a corporate, RPO or agency setting. Experience using recruitment technologies such as Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and social media tools.
Functional/Technical Knowledg

title: Affiliate Marketing Manager
description:
Role overview
Owns Kraymer Art 's affiliate and creator program end to end, from sourcing creators through tracking, payout, and reporting. Builds the systems and relationships that turn a warm anime audience into a repeatable growth channel. Works with the founder and marketing on turning creator content into affiliate, organic, and paid opportunities.
What you'll do

• Own the affiliate and creator program end to end, sourcing through payout and reporting.

• Source and qualify anime, gaming, fashion, and lifestyle creators by brand fit, audience, engagement, and content quality.

• Set up and manage affiliate tracking in Social Snowball or a comparable tool: creator programs, tracked links, discount codes, and onboarding.

• Run outreach, follow-up, gifting, and creator agreements without letting relationships slip.

• Build and maintain the creator database, outreach templates, and performance reporting.

• Turn strong creator content into affiliate, organic, and paid ad opportunities, including whitelisting into paid.

• Build a tiered ambassador or referral program where creators recruit other creators.

Must-haves

• Proven affiliate marketing experience, with a program you personally ran.

• Hands-on experience with Social Snowball, UpPromote, Refersion, or a similar affiliate and referral platform.

• Creator or influencer marketing experience for an ecommerce brand.

• Shopify experience.

• Genuine anime knowledge and familiarity with fandom communities.

• Written and spoken English at C2 level. This is a hard requirement.

The details

• Fully remote, open to applicants in any country.

• 40 hours per week, flexible hours, choose your own schedule.

• Pay is US$6 to US$15 per hour based on experience. If your rate expectation is above this range, this is not the role for you. Please do not apply.

• Long-term role with full-time potential.

If this fits your experience and the pay band works for you, apply. To help us find thoughtful applicants, please write the word "seesaw" in your response to the first screening question on the application page.

title: Business Development Manager (US-Based)
description:
This role is perfect for someone who lights up walking into a room full of people, a conference reception, a dinner, or a happy hour after an event.
You're a natural networker who remembers names and turns small talk into relationships.
You're not interested in dialing for dollars or cold call quotas. What gets you going is nurturing a prospect for months until the timing is right.
If this sounds like you, Fire&Spark wants to talk. We host a dozen in-person events and 2 dozen virtual events per year, for exactly the buyers we want to reach, and host two virtual events every month. Event attendees trust our thought leadership.
We need someone in the room turning that trust into relationships, and relationships into revenue.
About Fire&Spark
Fire&Spark is an AI Search agency built on a simple conviction: AI search is won by earning trust and making brands intelligible to AI, not by gaming algorithms. Founded and led by the CEO, a recognized authority on SEO and AI Search Optimization (GEO), we help ambitious brands turn organic search into a durable growth engine. We work with enterprise and high-growth companies, with deep specialization in digital health, and we operate by a set of core values: intellectual honesty, relentless curiosity, and doing work we're proud to put our name on.
The Assets You'll Work With

• Proprietary events - up to 12 curated events per year, with 20-35 attendees, mostly within our ideal customer profile

• High-profile speaking platform - our CEO speaks at 12 to 15 conferences a year, including UNBOUND, Content Marketing World, and MAICON

• Live virtual events - 2 per month, 100-600 registrations each

• Engaged audience - An engaged email/LinkedIn audience and growing library of thought leadership content

The Goals of This Role

• Connect with people live, sometimes in person at our events

• Develop deep familiarity with Fire&Spark's agency and services

• Nurture prospects over time, building trust before pushing a sales agenda

• Know when it's time to shift a relationship into a sales conversation

• Generate sales-qualified leads for our sales team to close

What You'll Be Doing

• Work our conference calendar and proprietary events end-to-end - pre-event research, in-room relationship-building, and post-event follow-through

• Attend 4-8 in-person events per year

• Build and nurture relationships with our email and event audience over weeks and months, not automated drip sequences

• Diligently document every sales conversation and relationship touchpoint in our CRM

• Bring ideas for new partnerships, offers, and ways to extend our thought leadership reach

Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary: up to $85K per year, depending on experience and track record

• Sales commission based on performance

• Conference bonus: additional performance bonuses tied to successful conference relationship-building

• 401k match up to 4%

• Health and dental insurance

• 15 days vacation + 5 days paid sick leave + 10 paid holidays

• $500 annual wellness stipend

• $750 annual remote work stipend

Skills You'll Bring to the Table
Must-Have

• A genuine love of people

• Comfortable and confident working a room

• Disciplined about CRM documentation

• US-based, authorized to work in the US

• Able to travel roughly once a month for an event

Essential Qualities

• Relationship building

• Patience and judgment

• Proactively bring partnership ideas

• Strong communicator

Bonus Points

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Clay, or similar) to prep for conversations and stay organized

• Background in marketing agencies, especially AI Search, SEO, or content marketing

• Experience with enterprise-level B2B prospects

• Healthcare or regulated-industry exposure

title: Account Executive (Early Career)
description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly gives Main Street businesses the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it. We only get paid one way: when they make real money. We own the entire system of record, all business applications (we replace ServiceTitan, House Call Pro, RingCentral, Squarespace, Docusign, Square, and a dozen other applications), and dozens of AI agents ourselves embedded natively inside our business applications, with native data read & write access to our system of record. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready AI Agents to our customers in under 30 minutes with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.
Wonderly has the most result-driven business model, because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents work. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - we deliver real revenue and profit to our customers. All of our software and AI Agents are free - we charge a % of revenue we deliver for our customers. Each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve their revenue by 5-20%. This is the ultimate outcome-based pricing, only possible when you own the entire end-to-end system and all the agents yourself.
Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months of stealth to build. We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $2T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion) - all that $ gets pumped into Wonderly .
About the Hiring Manager
Hey, I'm Bishop, Head of Customer Experience at Wonderly .
I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.
I'm hiring early-career AEs who can talk to service business owners, understand their business quickly, and bring in the right customers. The bar is high. The work is fast. The reps are constant.
The Role
You will run the front of our funnel.
That means:

• Talking to service business owners every day

• Understanding their business quickly: what they do, who they serve, where their funnel is leaking

• Deciding who's a fit for Wonderly and who isn't

• Communicating clearly what we do and what they should expect

• Owning the customer's first experience with Wonderly

The work is high-volume and customer-facing. The decisions you make on each call have direct downstream effects on whether customers succeed.
What Makes This Role Different
Most early-career AE roles are pipeline-management jobs. You log activity in a CRM, send follow-up emails for weeks, manage handoffs, optimize for booked calls. The bar is activity.
The bar here is judgment. You're talking to small business owners who've been around for years, in industries you've never worked in. Your job is to understand their business in 10 minutes and make a real call about whether Wonderly is right for them. Then bring them in clean or send them away clean.
You'll get more reps, more depth on each conversation, and more accountability than at most traditional sales orgs. The work is closer to a partner-track role at a top firm than a typical SaaS AE.
Backgrounds That Tend to Work
People from these backgrounds tend to thrive:

• New grads from competitive schools who ran something significant in college

• 1-2 years at a fast-growing startup in a closing role

• Anyone who has sold their own product or run their own business

• Top performers from high-volume inside-sales orgs

• Consulting backgrounds with strong client-facing skills

What matters more than the resume:

• You quickly understand businesses you've never seen before

• You're confident on calls without being aggressive

• You can disqualify cleanly when someone doesn't fit

• You measure yourself on outco

description:
FORTNA partners with the world’s leading brands to transform omnichannel and parcel distribution operations. Known world-wide for enabling companies to keep pace with digital disruption and growth objectives, we design and deliver solutions, powered by intelligent software, to optimize fast, accurate and cost-effective order fulfillment and last mile delivery. Our people, innovative approach and proprietary algorithms and tools ensure optimal operations design and material and information flow. We deliver exceptional value every day to our customers with comprehensive services and products including network strategy, distribution center operational design and implementation, material handling automated equipment, robotics and a comprehensive suite of lifecycle services.

At FORTNA , we believe in fostering a workplace that isn't just a job but a movement - a collective effort to redefine success and transform challenges into opportunities. "Join the Movement" encapsulates our commitment to a workplace culture that thrives on collaboration, celebrates diversity, and empowers every individual to contribute to something greater than themselves. Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach.

Position Summary

The Problem Manager leads the identification, investigation, analysis, and permanent resolution of recurring and high-impact incidents affecting automated material handling and warehouse automation systems. The role reduces operational disruption by identifying root causes and coordinating corrective and preventive actions across WES, WCS, WMS, controls, PLCs, robotics, material handling equipment, databases, networks, and related integrations.

The Problem Manager is the central owner of the Problem Management lifecycle for complex customer and production issues, working closely with Technical Support, Software Engineering, Controls Engineering, Site Operations, Customer Success, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Infrastructure, and third-party vendors to prevent repeat incidents and improve system reliability.

This role partners closely with Incident Management but owns a distinct piece of the lifecycle: Incident Managers own real-time restoration during an active incident, while the Problem Manager owns root-cause investigation and permanent resolution once an incident is stabilized or identified as recurring.

Key Responsibilities

1. Problem Management Ownership

• Own and manage the end-to-end Problem Management process for recurring, major, complex, and high-business-impact incidents.

• Identify patterns across incidents, tickets, alerts, and escalations; determine when related incidents represent a common problem requiring formal root cause investigation.

• Lead structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, Fault Tree Analysis, Pareto, FMEA, or Kepner-Tregoe.

• Facilitate cross-functional RCA sessions with Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, and Operations, ensuring findings are evidence-based rather than symptom-based.

• Establish and maintain formal Problem Records and Known Error Database (KEDB) entries - root cause, workaround, corrective/preventive action, ownership, and closure criteria.

• Prioritize problems by customer impact, operational risk, frequency, severity, downtime, and recurrence likelihood.

• Develop, assign, and track Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans, and validate that fixes materially reduce recurrence before closing problems.

• Identify systemic issues affecting multiple customers or platforms, escalate significant risks to leadership, and provide regular reporting on major problems and root-cause trends.

2. WES/WCS and Automation Troubleshooting

• Lead investigations spanning WES/WCS and their integration with WMS, ERP, PLCs, robotics, conveyors, AS/RS, AMRs, and related automation technologies.

• Analyze failures across the order, task, and routing lifecycle - work release, task generation, divert logic, inventory movement, and tote

私たちの使命は、放射線医学の領域を革新し続けることで、「予防医療」へのアクセシビリティを劇的に高めることです。 MRI検査をより身近なものへと進化させ、病気の早期発見と予防が中心となる新しい医療モデルを世界中で実現していきます。
■主力製品：SwiftMR
当社の主力製品である「SwiftMR」は、AIディープラーニングモデルを用いたベンダーニュートラルのMRI画像再構成ソリューションです。

• 課題の解決: 従来のMRI検査の課題であった「長い検査時間」と「高コスト」を解消し、より効率的で費用対効果の高い検査を実現します。

• 提供価値: MRIをより身近な診断ツールへと進化させ、医療従事者が潜在的な健康リスクを早期に発見できるようサポートします。

■グローバルな実績と評価
私たちの技術力は世界的に認められており、急速な成長を遂げています。

• 導入実績: 世界40カ国以上、1,400以上の医療機関で導入されています。

• 受賞歴:

• 2023年 Frost & Sullivanにて「Technology Innovation Leadership Award」受賞

• 2019年・2020年 fastMRI Challenge（Facebook AI ResearchおよびNYU Langone Health主催）にて連続優勝

• グローバル展開: 韓国を拠点に、米国、欧州、日本に法人を設立し、グローバル市場で事業を拡大しています。

🚩Roles & Responsibilities
自社製品（SwiftMR）の導入支援やMRI撮像パラメータの最適化を通じて、顧客のビジネス価値と満足度を最大化させるポジションです。新規導入からトラブルシューティング、ソウル本社を含むアメリカやEMEAなど海外法人の仲間や国内営業部門との連携までを担い、試用から有料契約・更新へと導きます。

title: Independent Contractor (Spanish/English) Transcription/Translation
description:
What you will do:
As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.
We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.
Who we’re looking for:

• U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.

• Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.

• Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.

• People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

• Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.

• Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

• A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.

• For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.

• Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.

• ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?
No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

• Current resume (PDF)

• Cover letter (PDF)

• A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

title: Product Partnership Engineer
description:
TL;DR: We’re hiring a Product Partnership Engineer to build and scale Lovable’s most strategic product partnerships. You’ll work directly with enterprise partners to design and ship high-impact integrations, reading their stack, prototyping solutions yourself, and shaping both our roadmap and theirs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and enterprise relationships, and will directly accelerate Lovable’s ecosystem growth and enterprise adoption.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years in Partner Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or as a technical founder/CTO - in high-velocity environments.

- Fluent in modern frontend (React/TypeScript) and/or backend (Golang, Rust) development.

- Track record of structuring and executing product-centric partnerships that involve real technical depth.

- Genuinely technical; comfortable reading technical documentation, understanding cloud architectures, and forming independent views on integration feasibility.

- Strong enterprise and commercial instincts: comfortable navigating senior stakeholders in negotiating, building relationships and managing complex deals while maintaining technical credibility.

- High agency and bias for action; you prototype first and refine later than waiting for full specs.

What you’ll do

- Own and deepen relationships with Lovable’s most strategic product and enterprise partners - driving urgency, alignment, and executive-level momentum.

- Independently assess partner architectures, APIs, and other integration points to identify high-impact integration opportunities, validate feasibility, and proactively surface risks or blockers.

- Prototype and spike early integrations yourself to shape requirements, accelerate decision-making, and reduce engineering lift.

- Scope and, where appropriate, ship production-ready integrations that deliver measurable value to Lovable users and our partners.

- Develop compelling business cases for integrations that clearly demonstrate long-term value creation for partners, Lovable, and end customers with a strong focus on measurable impact.

The Role

- Facilitate structured problem-solving and corrective-action activities when projects encounter significant execution issues

- Help develop and continuously improve Navflex's project-management processes, templates, and operatin

description:
We're looking for a skilled System Administrator to join our Customer Support Operations & Strategy team. In this role, you'll be the backbone of our support infrastructure - ensuring that our systems are secure, reliable, and always optimized for performance. As Mercury's Zendesk ecosystem and CS tech stack continue to grow in scope and complexity - and as we move toward a bank charter* - this role is increasingly central to how we scale, automate, and govern our systems. If you're excited about building creative solutions and making a tangible impact on customer & agent experience, we'd love to hear from you!

• Manage our Zendesk implementation - both intraday maintenance and supporting Zendesk through strategic business growth

• Develop and maintain an internal comprehensive knowledge base for our Zendesk configuration & procedures

• Primary partner to engineering teams; ensuring Zendesk is continuously improving internally

• Collaborate with business teams on process improvements, change control, and project status updates

• Stay current with industry trends and best practices, bringing a voice and point of view to our strategic programs

• Lead initiatives that simplify and improve the experience for customers, agents, and the business

• 3-5 years of hands-on Zendesk Administrator experience; demonstration of strong knowledge of the Zendesk platform

• Knowledge of system security, monitoring tools, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or similar)

With millions of customers worldwide , we're not just changing how people access financial products - we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The opportunity - Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA
We’re looking for a strong Senior Software Engineer to join NIRA’s engineering team. You will have the opportunity to shape strategy for the infrastructure and product roadmap. This role will give you the ability to have a direct and outsized impact on technical projects, leading to enormous potential for career-growth.
This role is Hybrid, based in our Bangalore office 2-3 days/week.
How you'll make an impact

• Work closely with the local NIRA Engineering team, and partner with the broader APAC Engineering team to increase the scale our platform can handle.

• Expand the platform to support multiple financial products and underlying instruments.

• Drive iterations on credit policy and improve credit decision systems.

• Collaborate with product, credit/finance, compliance, support and analytics teams.

Why you're a great fit

• Strong experience using Java (ideally .net too).

• Demonstrated experience working in AWS-native environments, using tools like DynamoDB, Athena and Lambda.

• You have experience with scaled technical solutions - have worked on projects to increase the scaleability of a platform.

• Clear communicator, ability to clearly articulate technical solutions and collaborate with colleagues globally.

• Product Engineer mentality - own your solutions from start to finish.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.
What you'll get at Tilt

• Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

• Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

• Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

• Visibility is yours : You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team - we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

• Paid global onsites : Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

• Impact is recognized : Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way
We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable - brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Nift ’s mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years. Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide.
Backed by Spark Capital & Foundry who also invested in Slack, Snap, SeatGeek, Fitbit, Warby Parker, Wayfair and Twitter, we are poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale. Read more about our growth here.
What you will do:

• ML platform: Productionize training and inference (batch/real-time), establish CI/CD for models, data/versioning practices, and model governance

• Feature & model lifecycle: Centralize feature generation (e.g., feature store patterns), manage model registry/metadata, and streamline deployment workflows

• Observability & quality: Implement monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance/latency, and pipeline health with clear alerting and dashboards

• Engineering excellence: Refactor research code into reusable components, enforce repo structure, testing, logging, and reproducibility

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work with DS/Analytics/Engineers to turn prototypes into production systems, provide mentorship and technical guidance

• Roadmap & standards: Drive the technical vision for ML platform capabilities and establish architectural patterns that become team standards

What you need:

• Experience: 5+ years in ML Ops, including ownership of ML infrastructure for large-scale systems

• Software engineering strength: Strong coding, debugging, performance analysis, testing, and CI/CD discipline; reproducible builds. Extensive commercial experience with Python developing automated pipelines bringing ML models to production

• Cloud & containers: Production experience on AWS, DataBricks, Docker + Kubernetes (EKS/ECS or equivalent)

• IaC: Terraform or CloudFormation for managed, reviewable environments

• ML tooling: MLflow/SageMaker (or similar) with a track record of production ML pipelines

• Monitoring/observability: ML monitoring (quality, drift, performance) and pipeline alerting

• Collaboration: Excellent communication, comfortable working with data scientists, analysts, and engineers in a fast-paced startup

• PySpark/Glue/Dask/Kafka: Experience with large-scale batch/stream processing

• Analytics platforms: Experience integrating 3rd party data

• Model serving patterns: Familiarity with real-time endpoints, batch scoring, and feature stores

• Governance & security: Exposure to model governance/compliance and secure ML operations

• Be mission-oriented: Proactive and self-driven with a strong sense of initiative; takes ownership, goes beyond expectations, and does what's needed to get the job done

What you get:

• Competitive compensation, flexible remote work

• Unlimited Responsible PTO

• Great opportunity to join a growing, cash-flow-positive company while having a direct impact on Nift 's revenue, growth, scale, and future success

Join Amgen ’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen , if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. The Supply Chain Manager will drive supply planning, material readiness, and delivery of pre-clinical, clinical, and PPQ products manufactured at Amgen ’s Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).
The role will partner with Global Supply Chain, Product Teams, Amgen Contract Manufacturing, CMOs, and other cross-functional partners to design and implement supply chain solutions for new external manufacturing sites. The Supply Chain Manager will translate program demand and manufacturing requirements into executable supply plans, assess supply constraints and risks, and coordinate mitigation actions to enable timely decisions and reliable supply.

• Overseeing timely, compliant execution of assigned site-level supply chain operations and financial flows, including inventory, order and invoice management, and coordination of material movements.

• Ensuring applicable operating standards and supply chain requirements for technology transfer and new product introduction are implemented and sustained at managed sites.

title: Mission Operations Lead, Maritime

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface, surface, land, and air domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of multi-mission capability to our customers. Deciding what to build - and in what order - requires people who can connect operational problems, threat-informed scenarios, customer needs, and product employment concepts to the capability we field. We are looking for a Mission Operations Lead to do that work at the enterprise level, based at our Costa Mesa, California headquarters.

ABOUT THE JOB

Our next Mission Operations Lead has built and executed plans in the maritime domain, has stood watch, and has been to sea, preferably using uncrewed systems. That background is what separates an analytic product that operators recognize as real from one that reads well and gets ignored. Equally important is the ability to carry that work into a room of senior military and civilian decision-makers and hold it there: this role briefs Commanding Officers, high-level civilians, and our own executive team, and it is expected to give direct answers under hard questioning.

Customer engagement is key, with opportunity to embed directly with our warfighters to provide real-time analysis and feedback on Anduril products. You will normalize how mission problems are framed so that competing programs can be compared on the same terms, and so that investment, roadmap, and capture decisions rest on a defensible operational argument rather than on whichever program briefed most recently.

Being co-located with product leadership, engineering leads, growth, and program directors is the point of the job. You will spend your days in the rooms where trades get made: pressure-testing a concept of employment with the engineers who have to build it, reconciling a program director’s field reality with a product lead’s roadmap, and giving executives the one-page operational case they need to commit capital. Expect up to 50% travel across company facilities, test and demonstration sites, waterfront and fleet concentration areas, and customer locations - the analysis has to survive contact with the water, not just the whiteboard.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Understand the enterprise-level mission analysis for the maritime portfolio - identify operational problems, capability gaps, and opportunities for differentiated system employment, and maintain a coherent picture of them across programs rather than one program at a time and be able to communicate them to the customer across the Maritime suite of products

• Develop and refine concepts of operation, concepts of employment, operational vignettes, mission threads, and use cases for current and future systems, and keep them current as designs and customer priorities move

• Inform capability roadmaps, IRAD and investment prioritization, and product-market fit assessments by making the operational case for where the next dollar and the next engineer should go

• Analyze threat environments, customer missions, force structure, operational constraints, and campaign-level context, and translate that context into capability priorities and defensible requirements for product and engineering teams

• Compare alternative capability approaches and ass

title: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical

Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.
Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.
The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.
The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.
If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.
Location: We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.
What your day will look like

• Represent Canonical , its solutions and software to partners.

• Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical ’s current and future products.

• Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.

• Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.

• Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.

• Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you

• B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.

• Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.

• Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.

• Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.

• Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.

• Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels

• Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Additional skills that you might also bring

• Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.

description:

As an Examiner-in-Charge (EIC) for the Vermont Department of Financial Regulation, Captive Insurance Division, your primary responsibilities include examinations and ongoing oversight of Vermont domiciled captive insurance companies. Utilizing a risk-focused approach, an EIC leads a team of examiners in evaluating areas of captive insurance company operations and business practices, including corporate governance, strategy, business plan, IT systems, internal controls, financial reporting and regulatory compliance. An EIC also conducts research, is assigned special projects, and conducts annual and quarterly surveillance for a portfolio of companies. An EIC must be self motivated and possess strong time management, organization, critical thinking and communication skills.

This position, Insurance Examiner-In-Charge (Job Requisition #52725) , is open to all State employees and external applicants.

If you would like more information about this position, please contact .

Graduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field AND two (2) or more years of experience at or above a technical level in accounting, auditing, or financial examination, INCLUDING two (2) or more years involving insurance operations and supervisory responsibilities.

OR

Bachelor's degree AND four (4) or more years of experience at or above a technical level in accounting, auditing, or financial examination, INCLUDING two (2) or more years involving insurance operations and supervisory responsibilities.

One year as an Insurance Examiner III.

AFE (Accredited Financial Examiner), CFE (Certified Financial Examiner), or CPA (Certified Public Accountant) designations.

title: Director, Product Strategy & Transformation
description:
About the Role
Millions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance. As AI reshapes professional work, our customers expect software that is more intelligent, integrated and effective. Meeting those expectations requires rethinking how products are discovered, built, launched, measured and improved.
This newly created role reflects Wolters Kluwer 's commitment to transforming how products are built in the age of AI. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Product Strategy & Transformation, you will help lead that evolution from the Corporate Strategy Office. Working in a small enterprise team, you will partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to strengthen the Product System and improve customer value, business outcomes and speed of innovation. A key focus will be advancing the Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (Agentic PDLC), using AI across product development. You will combine deep product expertise with a hands-on transformation mindset to implement and scale change.
How You Will Work
This is a senior individual-contributor role, leading through expertise, coaching, facilitation and influence. You will embed with business-unit teams on high-priority lighthouse initiatives, apply modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows, and turn proven approaches into reusable tools and operating practices for broader adoption.
The role can be based remotely in any country where Wolters Kluwer has an office and will require travel of approximately 35% to work directly with teams and stakeholders.
What You Will Do

• Partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities and connect product decisions to customer and business outcomes.

• Define, pilot and scale Wolters Kluwer 's Agentic PDLC and broader AI-enabled product development capabilities.

• Lead lighthouse engagements across product strategy, discovery, experimentation, delivery, launch and measurement.

• Embed with cross-functional teams to diagnose barriers, build trust and translate insight into practical change.

• Coach product leaders and improve operating models, portfolio practices, governance and metrics.

• Turn effective practices into repeatable tools, learning experiences and standards for enterprise adoption.

• Establish success measures, demonstrate impact and use evidence to guide broader rollout.
Required Experience & Qualifications

• 8+ years of hands-on Product Management and/or Product Leadership experience in B2B software, SaaS or technology companies.

• Ownership of strategy and outcomes for a substantial product, platform or portfolio, from customer discovery through delivery and measurement.

• A track record of leading cross-functional product, engineering and design teams to meaningful customer and business outcomes.

• Strong product craft across discovery, strategy, experimentation, prioritization, roadmaps, launch and measurement.

• Recent hands-on experience building AI-enabled or agentic products, transforming product development workflows through AI, or both.

• Ability to enter unfamiliar contexts, diagnose root causes, build trust and translate insight into action.

• Proven influence on product direction, operating models or organizational effectiveness beyond a single team, without relying on formal authority.

• Strong analytical, communication, storytelling and facilitation skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity and align senior leaders.
Preferred Experience

• Leading product transformation, operating-model change or organizational scaling initiatives.

• Coaching product leaders and strengthening product management practices.

• Working across multiple businesses, portfolios or complex matrixed organizations.

title: Data Operations Assistant
description:
CerebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use. We bring together technology, data, and business expertise to create solutions that are scalable, reliable, and easy to use.
We are looking for a Data Operations Assistant to support the day-to-day handling, organization, and quality of business and product data. You will help maintain accurate records, process information across internal systems, and support teams that rely on reliable data for their daily work.
This is a practical, detail-focused role suited to someone who enjoys working with information, follows processes carefully, and is comfortable learning new software and tools.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Enter, update, and maintain information across internal systems and spreadsheets.

• Review data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

• Process information received from different internal and external sources.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent records and help resolve them.

• Organize and standardize data according to established guidelines.

• Perform regular data checks and routine quality-control tasks.

• Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and operational records.

• Prepare basic reports and summaries for internal teams.

• Follow documented procedures for data processing and updates.

• Work with Operations, Product, and Data teams to resolve data-related issues.

• Keep documentation and process instructions up to date.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 0-2 years of experience in data entry, administration, operations, or a related role.

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and web-based business systems.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to follow processes and handle repetitive tasks consistently.

• Good organizational and time-management skills.

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Comfortable learning new software and working independently.

• Clear written communication skills.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience working with databases, CRM systems, or other business applications.

• Familiarity with data quality or data-processing tasks.

• Basic knowledge of reporting or data analysis.

• Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or operations environment.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
$48,000-$62,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
CerebriOS offers a remote-first work environment, opportunities to learn modern business and data tools, and a collaborative team environment where accuracy, organization, and continuous improvement are valued.
HIRING PROCESS
Application review → recruiter screen → short practical assessment → final team interview → offer.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
CerebriOS is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and consider qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
Location: Remote

Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. An interest in e-commerce, food retail, health, wellness, or customer experience industries is highly desirable.

Work-from-Home Requirements

•
Reliable wired internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps

title: Senior Social Media Marketer, Growth
description:
About Abridge
Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.
Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
We're looking for a Senior Social Media Marketer to own how Abridge grows across social. This is a role for someone who treats social as a performance channel with a funnel behind it: someone who can build an audience from a standing start, run a real experiment cadence, and connect audience growth to outcomes further down the funnel like email capture, content consumption, event registration, pipeline influence, and recruiting.
Abridge is an AI company building in healthcare, and we have the substance to build a meaningful public presence: a product that clinicians use and love, a team of practicing physicians and AI researchers, and a CEO who is himself a practicing cardiologist. Two conversations we should be central to, the AI conversation and the healthcare conversation, are happening every day on social without us in them. What we need is someone who can close that gap deliberately, with a plan, a stack, and a number they're accountable to.
Writing matters in this role. You'll be publishing in the brand voice and in the voices of our executives and clinicians, and the work has to be native and genuinely good. But the hard requirement here is growth: we're looking for a growth operator who writes well, not a writer who also reads dashboards. You'll have editorial and creative partners for the craft, and you'll be the one deciding what to test, what to scale, what to kill, and what any of it did for the business.
This role reports into Growth and partners closely with Creative, Comms, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Events, and Recruiting. You'll own social strategy, channel prioritization, distribution, experimentation, and measurement end to end.
What You'll Do

• Own audience growth as a number. Set and hit targets for follower growth, reach, and engaged audience by platform, and own the framework that connects social activity to ToFu, MoFu, and BoFu outcomes. Be able to say what a month of work produced and what you'd do differently next month.

• Build and own the measurement layer. Define the metrics that matter, instrument the tracking (UTM discipline, analytics, self-reported attribution, event and campaign tagging), and report to marketing leadership on a regular cadence. Bring insights back that change what we make.

• Run a continuous experiment program. Maintain a live backlog of hypotheses across hooks, formats, cadence, first frames and thumbnails, posting time, cross-posting, and audience targeting. Design tests that can actually be read, and be disciplined about killing what doesn't work.

• Decide which platforms we play on and how. Own LinkedIn and X as our primary channels, and make the call on where else we should be investing across Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, TikTok, etc. Each one has a different audience, algorithm, and reason to exist for us.

• Build the growth stack outside the native platforms. Stand up and operate the too

title: Product Quality Engineer, Automotive Sensors
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

You will:

• Champion Product Quality & APQP/PPAP: Serve as the quality champion across the autonomous driving sensor development team (Cameras, Radars, Lidars), driving design methodologies and executing end-to-end quality plans (APQP and PPAP) from concept through mass production to ensure robust, reliable sensor modules that meet specifications.

• Specification Compliance & Design Lifecycle (DFx/FMEA): Verify and enforce full compliance with the Engineering Requirement Specification (ERS) and sensor specification matrices; oversee the product design lifecycle by facilitating DFMEA, PFMEA, design reviews, DFM/DFA, and DFx for optical, RF/mmWave, and electro-mechanical sensor assemblies.

• Sensor Characterization, Calibration & EOL Test Validation: Partner with optical, RF, hardware, firmware, and test engineering teams to define and validate sensor calibration, active alignment, RF/antenna performance, and End-of-Line (EOL) functional test coverage, limits, and Measurement System Analysis (MSA/GR&R).

• Failure Analysis, Debug & 8D Problem Solving: Perform hands-on initial failure analysis (FA) and hardware/system debug for Camera and Radar modules, supporting sensor module bring-up and vehicle integration while driving cross-functional 8D root-cause investigations and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) to closure.

• Cross-Functional Partnership & Standards Compliance: Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and Tier-1/contract manufacturing partners to execute quality plans, conduct process audits and product inspections, and ensure strict compliance with automotive quality, reliability, and safety standards (IATF 16949, ISO 26262, AEC-Q100/Q200, ASPICE).

• Yield Management & Data Analytics: Establish and monitor manufacturing yields, defect rates (DPPM), Cp/Cpk, and reliability metrics; apply statistical tools (SPC, DOE) to analyze data from early development, reliability qualification, production, and field operations to drive continuous improvement and incorporate lessons learned into the Sensors PDP.

You have:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Optical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• 10+ years of automotive industry experience in design/hardware engineering for automotive product development, focusing on ADAS/autonomous sensors.

• Proficiency in core quality tools and methodologies: APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA (Measurement System Analysis), SPC (Statistical Process Control), DOE and 8D problem-solving.

• Working knowledge of automotive quality and safety standards (IATF 16949, ISO 26262).

• Experience with data analysis, statistical tools, and quality control systems

• Excellent cross-functional communication skills with the ability to translate complex engineering issues to leadership and external suppliers.

We prefer:

• Master's degree in Electrical, Mechanical Engineer
